$comment: Cosmetics of the Eldrazi Void set (Tabletop Atelier capsule machine), written by art/machine-specs.mjs from career/machines/tabletop-atelier.json: edit that file and re-run, not this one.
style: alien geometric wasteland painting in chalky bone, floating bismuth crystals, and deep violet aurora
rules: Each item belongs to a unified tabletop cosmetic collection sharing the exact same palette, brushwork, and motif. No text, letters, numbers, logos, or borders.
spare: an extra painting in the same style: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Eldrazi Void

items.subject: a wide serene tabletop playmat evoking Eldrazi Void. A wide 16:9 tabletop playmat with a calm, low-contrast textured center so playing cards read crisply over it, and painterly theme accents along the outer edges.
a painterly fantasy portrait bust of Void Seer in the theme of Eldrazi Void. A centered bust portrait medallion subject with dramatic workshop lighting and clean silhouette.

an adorable small magical tabletop companion creature, Prism Scion, matching Eldrazi Void. A charming tabletop companion creature in full-body view centered with breathing room around it on a deep moody background.
a circular ornamental portrait frame medallion titled Fractured Halo in the style of Eldrazi Void. An ornate circular portrait border motif with clean dark interior so an avatar sits inside it.
an ornate vertical Command-Zone card border frame titled Void Command matching Eldrazi Void. An ornate vertical rectangular border frame for a commander card slot with a calm dark interior center.

the BACK of a playing card in the same style: a symmetrical ornamental design (it is seen upside down too) with a central emblem drawn from this set's theme, framed by a painted border; no logo, no oval, no five dots, no lettering
